summary: Small ski boat carrying three people began taking on water and sank Saturday evening shortly after launching at Lake Pueblo State Park; witnesses on shore and CPW park rangers attempted a rescue; the two passengers wearing life jackets resurfaced; the third passenger's body was recovered by Pueblo County Sheriff's Office divers
responding_agency: CPW rangers; Pueblo County Sheriff's Office dive team
notes: Story 'Two Survive Sinking Boat in Lake Pueblo; Pueblo County Divers Recover Body of Third Passenger' (carries the CPW release) on the Prowers Journal 2023-07-17 archive page, parent-opened this run; direct article URL not recoverable (browser-tool fetch failed)
